text: Who satisfies your years with good things, So that your youth is renewed like the [soaring] eagle.
For He knows our [mortal] frame; He remembers that we are [merely] dust.
To those who honor and keep His covenant, And remember to do His commandments [imprinting His word on their hearts].
Bless the LORD, all you works of His, in all places of His dominion; Bless and affectionately praise the LORD, O my soul!
